verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is an API-first platform. Its documented server-side SDKs automate request signing, and payments on an authorised mandate execute without further user interaction, so programmatic headless automation is directly supported. However, nothing documents a CLI, CI pipeline usage, or non-interactive test-environment automation; the quickstart covers only a single test payment. Missing for 10: documented CLI or CI/headless runner guidance, non-interactive sandbox automation for test pipelines (bank authorisation steps), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Once you create a payment on an authorised mandate, it executes immediately without requiring further user authorisation.
They also automate request signing for all Payments POST requests, reducing the need for manual configuration.
SDKs for Node.js, Python, Java and .NET.
complete your first test payment with the Payments API v3
